title: Agent chat hardening: thread-scoped streaming patches + persist-on-terminal + memoize markdown
description: Audit of the just-merged chat threads/markdown (1290/1291) found one correctness race + two perf issues. Fix all (same files): (1) CORRECTNESS — streaming run patches currently target the LIVE activeThreadId at callback time (threadStore.ts patchActiveAssistantRun ~331-347; AgentChatPanel.tsx onState ~176-235). If activeThreadId changes after a run starts but before/while deltas arrive (rapid New-chat/switch race or React batching), patches land in the WRONG thread. Fix: capture the target threadId (the thread the run was started on) at send time and patch THAT thread explicitly (e.g. patchAssistantRun(threadId, assistantId, run)), not whatever is active now. Add a safety net: if the active thread changes while a run is in-flight, abort the run (or otherwise guarantee the in-flight stream only mutates its origin thread). Keep the existing if(running) return UI guards. (2) PERF/durability — patchActiveAssistantRun persists to localStorage on EVERY streaming delta (thrash + quota). Keep the live run state in memory for UI updates, but only PERSIST to localStorage on terminal state (done/error/stopped) and on history append (and maybe a low-rate debounce). IMPORTANT: also coerce any thread left in a non-terminal 'running' run to a terminal state ('stopped' or cleared run) on hydrate/load, so a mid-run page refresh doesn't leave a thread stuck 'running' forever. (3) PERF — AgentMarkdown re-parses the full growing text on every delta (O(n^2) on long responses). Wrap AgentMarkdown in React.memo keyed on its text/props so unchanged bubbles don't re-parse. PRESERVE all existing behavior + tests (markdown safety, streaming, Stop, multi-turn history, persistence round-trip, selectable text). VERIFY ground truth first. TEST: add unit tests — a run started on thread A keeps patching A after activeThreadId switches to B (or aborts on switch); persistence does NOT write per-delta (write count bounded) and DOES persist terminal state; a hydrated 'running' thread becomes terminal; markdown memoization doesn't break rendering. Build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable); agent-chat e2e oracle still passes. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Scope: threadStore.ts, AgentChatPanel.tsx, AgentMarkdown.tsx (+ tests).
